games.title: Boom Relay: City Defense
games.tagline_id: Tangkap dan lempar balik bom sebelum kotamu hancur.
games.tagline_en: Catch the bombs and throw them back before your city falls.

games.title: Kurir Mania
games.tagline_id: Jadi kurir motor: ambil paket, kejar waktu, taat lalu lintas.
games.tagline_en: Ride as a courier: grab parcels, beat the clock, mind the traffic.

games.title: Territory Merge: Strategi Hex
games.tagline_id: Gabungkan unit kembar, rebut wilayah hex, hancurkan markas musuh.
games.tagline_en: Merge twin units, take the hex map, topple the enemy base.

games.title: Gravity Chain: Puzzle Blok
games.tagline_id: Sambungkan 3 warna sama sampai lantai, picu kombo berantai.
games.tagline_en: Link 3 matching colours to the floor and set off chain combos.

games.title: Warung Chaos: Dapur Nusantara
games.tagline_id: Masak serba cepat di warung dari seluruh Nusantara.
games.tagline_en: Fast-paced cooking in food stalls from across Indonesia.

games.title: Echo Pulse
games.tagline_id: Dengarkan frasanya, ulangi dari ingatan, bangun jalanmu.
games.tagline_en: Hear the phrase, echo it from memory, build your path.
